name: ai-bridge
description: Run a local relay bridge for Claude / Codex subscriptions.

interface.shortDescription: Local relay bridge for Claude Code and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Starts a local Node bridge that relays Anthropic Messages and OpenAI Responses requests through this machine's Claude / Codex subscription login. Manages access tokens with scopes, per-token concurrency and IP allowlists. Designed as a module host so more capabilities can be added later.
defaultPrompt: 启动 ai-bridge 中转服务
给同事生成一个中转 token
